classification: per-card power draw of one NVIDIA RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell SFF Edition: an idle reading and a load range observed under inference load; workload not pinned; not a specification, not a TDP, not a fit or capacity claim

card.name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell SFF Edition
card.power_limit_source: nvidia-smi power.limit, power.min_limit and power.max_limit columns, identical in every row of both files (driver-reported)

datasheet.quote: Power Consumption Total board power: 70 W
datasheet.evidence_grade: Primary documentation (vendor specification value; not independently reproduced here)

idle.evidence_grade: Independent measurement (self-collected nvidia-smi readings; method stated below); the summary statistics are derived by this project from those readings
idle.qualifying_rows_rule: first consecutive rows of GPU index 0 in the IDLE file with utilization 0 percent, memory used exactly 244 MiB and pstate P5 in every row

excluded_rows.rule: the four rows after the idle run are not idle: the card began loading a model (utilization 0-2 percent, memory 258-723 MiB, pstate P0); they are excluded from the idle figure and never mixed into it

load.evidence_grade: Independent measurement (self-collected nvidia-smi readings; method stated below); the summary statistics are derived by this project from those readings
load.qualifying_rows_rule: rows with utilization 80 percent or higher, one series per card per file

range_of_series_means_w.note: range of per-series means across the three series; reported as a range, not as one number

load.above_limit_note: individual samples exceed the 70.00 W driver-reported power limit (maximum sample 71.25 W); the board draws slightly above the limit for single samples
load.not_a_spec: the load range is observed under inference load on a shared host whose workload, model and engine were not pinned; it is not a specification, not a TDP, and not a fit or capacity claim

raw_evidence.preservation: published files are the captures with the uuid column value replaced by REDACTED in every data row; header, other columns, PCI bus ids and line endings are unchanged
raw_evidence.redaction: uuid column replaced with REDACTED; no other change; original_sha256 is the hash of the unredacted capture

method: Statistics recomputed from the raw CSV files by tests/test_t2_sff_power_record.py (csv module, values rounded to two decimals); the test asserts agreement with this record within 0.01 W and checks both sha256 values. Timestamps are those recorded in the files.
not_included: per-process power attribution for the load series
workload definition for the load series
interpretation: Idle: power draw of one card with no model resident, in pstate P5. Load: power draw observed under inference load, as a range of per-series means with the maximum sample. Neither is a tested limit or a sizing input.
notes: Per-card figures only. Only the measured and derived values above are recorded; this record is not an admitted evidence item and no resource estimate is derived from it.
